claims.text: The exact amount of the Enhanced CPF Housing Grant (EHG) depends on factors such as household income, flat type, and the latest HDB grant rates, which may change over time.
For first‑timer married couples who are Singapore Citizens, the EHG is available for 2‑room, 3‑room, 4‑room, and 5‑room BTO flats, with the grant amount decreasing as household income rises.
As of the most recent HDB guidelines, households with a monthly combined income of up to $14,000 may be eligible for the EHG, but the exact grant amount is tiered (e.g., higher for lower incomes).
Check the latest EHG rates on the HDB website (hdb.gov.sg) or the HDB Flat Portal to see the grant amount that corresponds to a $9,000 monthly household income for a 4‑room BTO.
Prepare your latest payslips, Income Tax Notices of Assessment, and CPF contribution statements, as HDB will require these documents to verify your household income for the grant application.
If you have not yet received your HDB Flat Eligibility (HFE) letter, apply for it early, as the HFE is required before you can submit a BTO application and claim any grants.
